blocks.html:
During non-working hours, lumber shall be stored on the ground or street, or shall be stored in a fully enclosed room meeting its permanent fire rating. No more than 1,920 cubic feet (54.37 m 3 ) of lumber shall be stored at the site at any one time.
   Exception: Columns may be stored on the topmost working deck provided they are to be installed at the start of the next shift.
(Am. L.L. 2023/077, 6/11/2023, eff. 6/11/2023)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2023/077.
